✨ Zipline | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Accelerating and managing file downloads from various sources, including direct links, torrents, video streams, and cloud storage.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-connection downloads (up to 32 per file) • Resumable downloads across restarts and reboots • HLS/DASH stream downloading and conversion to MP4/WebM/MKV • Built-in torrent support (DHT, uTP, port mapping, etc.) • Support for cloud share links (Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, etc.)
📖 Summary: Zipline is a Go-based download manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It enhances download speeds through multi-connection downloads, supports various file types including torrents and video streams, and offers features like download resuming, scheduling, and bandwidth management.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 cl2metal | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a fast, secure, and feature-rich terminal and SSH client experience with integrated modal editing and secure agent access for developers.
✨ Key Features: • GPU-rendered terminal with advanced features (OSC 8/52, Kitty protocol, shell integration, panes, tabs) • Comprehensive SSH client (auth methods, jump hosts, forwards, config import, SFTP, remote file editing)
📖 Summary: cl2metal is a GPU-accelerated terminal and SSH client built in Rust. It features a modal editor, advanced terminal capabilities like panes and tabs, robust SSH support including config import and forwards, and integrates a consent-gated MCP agent broker for secure access by local coding agents.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 mercury-agent | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a persistent, customizable, and secure AI agent that runs locally, assisting users with a wide range of tasks from coding to research and automation, while maintaining user control over its actions and data.
✨ Key Features: • Soul-driven AI agent with customizable personality • Permission-hardened tools
📖 Summary: Mercury Agent is a soul-driven AI agent that runs locally on your machine, offering persistent memory, customizable personalities, and a robust permission system. It allows users to interact with the agent through various channels like CLI, Telegram, and Discord, enabling it to perform tasks such as reading/writing files, running commands, and managing code.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 witr | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Troubleshooting and understanding the root cause of running processes, services, and resource usage on a system.
✨ Key Features: • Trace process, port, container, or file origins • Answers "Why is this running?" • Provides human-readable reports • Outputs machine-readable JSON for scripts and AI agents • Interactive TUI dashboard
📖 Summary: witr is a command-line and TUI tool that traces the origin of running processes, ports, containers, and files. It answers the question "Why is this running?" by mapping entities back to their originating PID and detailing their ancestry, context, and dependencies, providing output in human-readable reports or machine-readable JSON.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 CloakBrowser | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Bypassing bot detection systems in web scraping and automation tasks.
✨ Key Features: • Source-level C++ patches for 87 browser fingerprints (canvas, WebGL, audio, etc.) • humanize=True flag for human-like mouse, keyboard, and scroll patterns • High scores on reCAPTCHA v3 and passes Cloudflare Turnstile, FingerprintJS, BrowserScan • Drop-in replacement for Playwright and Puppeteer with same API
📖 Summary: CloakBrowser is a stealthy Chromium browser designed to bypass bot detection systems. It functions as a drop-in replacement for Playwright and Puppeteer, offering source-level fingerprint patches to make automated browsers appear as normal users.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
